beats.vo: This is the Mueller Pro Chopper. 39,178 Amazon ratings, averaging 4.5 stars. So I dug through the reviews so you don't have to.
First, the good news: 8 interchangeable blades (dice, grate, slice, wedge) with a built-in storage tray that keeps everything in the base. That's the part that actually holds up in daily use.
Now the catch — Soft produce (ripe tomatoes, cooked potatoes) can turn mushy if you press too hard — requires a light touch. Nobody puts that in the listing photos.
The upside: 8 interchangeable blades. The tradeoff: soft produce. That's your call before checkout.
